shortDescription: Configuration for Gx interface Parameters resource.

options.name: api_path
options.description: Base NITRO API path. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: cerrequesttimeout
options.description: q!Healthcheck request timeout, in seconds, after which the Citrix ADC considers that no CCA packet received to the initiated CCR. After this time Citrix ADC should send again CCR to PCRF server. !

options.name: healthcheck
options.description: q!Set this setting to yes if Citrix ADC should send DWR packets to PCRF server. When the session is idle, healthcheck timer expires and DWR packets are initiated in order to check that PCRF server is active. By default set to No. !

options.name: healthcheckttl
options.description: q!Healthcheck timeout, in seconds, after which the DWR will be sent in order to ensure the state of the PCRF server. Any CCR, CCA, RAR or RRA message resets the timer. !

options.name: holdonsubscriberabsence
options.description: Set this setting to yes if Citrix ADC needs to Hold pakcets till subscriber session is fetched from PCRF. Else set to C(NO). By default set to yes. If this setting is set to C(NO), then till Citrix ADC fetches subscriber from PCRF, default subscriber profile will be applied to this subscriber if configured. If default subscriber profile is also not configured an undef would be raised to expressions which use Subscriber attributes.

options.name: idlettl
options.description: q!Idle Time, in seconds, after which the Gx CCR-U request will be sent after any PCRF activity on a session. Any RAR or CCA message resets the timer. Zero value disables the idle timeout. !

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_id
options.description: The ID of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_ip
options.description: The IP of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_name
options.description: The name of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_password
options.description: The password of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_username
options.description: The username of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: negativettl
options.description: q!Negative TTL, in seconds, after which the Gx CCR-I request will be resent for sessions that have not been resolved by PCRF due to server being down or no response or failed response. Instead of polling the PCRF server constantly, negative-TTL makes Citrix ADC stick to un-resolved session. Meanwhile Citrix ADC installs a negative session to avoid going to PCRF. For Negative Sessions, Netcaler inherits the attributes from default subscriber profile if default subscriber is configured. A default

options.name: negativettllimitedsuccess
options.description: Set this to C(YES) if Citrix ADC should create negative session for Result-Code DIAMETER_LIMITED_SUCCESS (2002) received in CCA-I. If set to C(NO), regular session is created.

options.name: netscaler_console_as_proxy_server
options.description: The IP address of the NetScaler ADC appliance acting as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nodeid
options.description: Unique number that identifies the cluster node.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the NetScaler ADC appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: pcrfrealm
options.description: PCRF realm is of type DiameterIdentity and contains the realm of PCRF to which the message is to be routed. This is the realm used in Destination-Realm AVP by Citrix ADC Gx client (as a Diameter node).

options.name: purgesdbongxfailure
options.description: Set this setting to C(YES) if needed to purge Subscriber Database in case of Gx failure. By default set to C(NO).

options.name: remove_non_updatable_params
options.description: When given yes, the module will remove any parameters that are not updatable in the resource. If no, the module will return error if any non-updatable parameters are provided.

options.name: requestretryattempts
options.description: If the request does not complete within requestTimeout time, the request is retransmitted for requestRetryAttempts time.

options.name: requesttimeout
options.description: q!Time, in seconds, within which the Gx CCR request must complete. If the request does not complete within this time, the request is retransmitted for requestRetryAttempts time. If still reuqest is not complete then default subscriber profile will be applied to this subscriber if configured. If default subscriber profile is also not configured an undef would be raised to expressions which use Subscriber attributes. Zero disables the timeout. !

options.name: revalidationtimeout
options.description: q!Revalidation Timeout, in seconds, after which the Gx CCR-U request will be sent after any PCRF activity on a session. Any RAR or CCA message resets the timer. Zero value disables the idle timeout. !

options.name: save_config
options.description: If C(true) the module will save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it made no changes.

options.name: service
options.description: Name of DIAMETER/SSL_DIAMETER service corresponding to PCRF to which the Gx connection is established. The service type of the service must be DIAMETER/SSL_DIAMETER. Mutually exclusive with vserver parameter. Therefore, you cannot set both Service and the Virtual Server in the Gx Interface.

options.name: servicepathavp
options.description: The AVP code in which PCRF sends service path applicable for subscriber.

options.name: servicepathvendorid
options.description: The vendorid of the AVP in which PCRF sends service path for subscriber.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(present), the resource will be added/updated configured according to the module's parameters. When C(unset), the resource will be unset on the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: vserver
options.description: Name of the load balancing, or content switching vserver to which the Gx connections are established. The service type of the virtual server must be DIAMETER/SSL_DIAMETER. Mutually exclusive with the service parameter. Therefore, you cannot set both service and the Virtual Server in the Gx Interface.
